Investment case

A highly compelling investment case as a focused, premium industrial engineering company.

Read more in investors

Strong market positions supported by structural growth trends with clear competitive advantages and growth prospects

Driving innovation to meet evolving customer needs and support growth

A customer-centric operating model with a high proportion of aftermarket and recurring revenue

A disciplined approach to capital allocation and growth investment, targeting attractive organic growth opportunities and value-accretive M&A

A high-performing culture with capabilities that deliver competitive advantage

A premium industrial financial profile – sustainable growth, high returns, strong cash generation and balance sheet strength

Our markets and strategy

We operate in four attractive markets – flow control, construction, thermal solutions and aerospace – where we have leading positions and differentiated proprietary technology and which are underpinned by powerful growth trends. Our growth strategy builds on these leading market positions. It is centred on four priorities – accelerate our growth initiatives, innovate with impact, execute relentlessly and compound value through M&A.
